text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate Market Garden Mews, between Queen Elizabeth Boulevard and Islington Avenue, one-way westbound, which will address concerns about cut-through traffic.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated Market Garden Mews, between Queen Elizabeth Boulevard and Islington Avenue, as one-way for westbound traffic only.
